findings.claim: Cultivation law content is declarative but read by a shared state machine: law loading sorts bottleneck locations, current law selects stages, and positive practice stops at the next fractional threshold until its distinct bottleneck is cleared. Aptitude mismatch changes efficiency rather than proving a universal hard admission gate.

Ordinary seated practice spends the Practice need per dt, gains stage value and tree experience, and restores Rest. Location element/ling, mental and emotional state, mentor effect, building effectiveness, season and event-driver modifiers alter the rate. The practice job prefers an assigned practice building, then room, then map; it can reconsider higher-priority work every five world-time units.

A normal Chance attempt obtains the configured required item, then consumes all configured ResourceCost entries and one item per ItemCost entry on toil entry, drains current Ling, waits CostTime, and attempts the current live chance on leave. The selected law Stage2 furnace bottleneck costs 10 maximum-age units and one Item_Dan_JingYuan2, not merely a possession check.

Chance probability combines configured base plus retry experience, then luck, mind and active medicine/property multipliers, additive sect fengshui/light/weather/season/location factors, retained core-grade modifier, and current consciousness; it clamps to 0..1. Parameters are read when TryBrokenNeck runs, not copied from the earlier preview. Water/metal light bonuses favor lower light; fire/wood favor higher light; earth favors intermediate light.

Failure is a stateful outcome: retry count increments, configured body damage is rolled, failure mood/modifier may persist, a configured non-Chance timestamp resets, and depleted stage value can move the actor back below the gate. The reviewed normal leave/failure path contains no refund for the entry-consumed items or maximum age. Success clears TouchNeck/retry count, applies rewards and can advance stage; stage advance reactivates equipment and informs difficulty.

Golden-core formation is a finite conversion, not the normal Chance roll: it drains 30 Ling per dt, accumulates GoldEffectSpeed per dt using live preparation/environment factors, and ends when Ling is empty. Normal Gold leave forces m_bDid true, calls MakeGold, records quality/grade and adds 0.015 times accumulated quality to energy capacity before clearing the bottleneck. This also banks current accumulated quality on interrupted leave in the reviewed code; exact zero-duration/cancellation ordering is unobserved.

Retained core quality affects more than its display. MakeGold alters NpcLingMaxValue; GlodDanEffectBroken selects a grade-dependent multiplier for later breakthroughs with a separate post-stage-9 table column. GoldLevel ranking runs 1 through 9 with grade 1 at the highest configured quality threshold, so higher quality must not be described as a larger grade number.

The selected law also contains a timed threat: Stage3 at 20 percent has a Thunder bottleneck with 4900 countdown units and 10000 configured ThunderValue. Outside RPG mode, expiry can automatically start the owned JobBrokenNeck; action incapacity/selected suppression states adjust or defer the countdown. Thunder/God jobs cannot be interrupted, while Chance/Gold normal jobs are not marked noninterruptible here.

Environment has implementation-backed meaning: light uses a biome/time curve and LightAddP; the seasonal phase is year-day minus ten wrapped over eight annual segments; weather applies/unapplies map-property values. Active XML samples set Overcast ShuiBroken +0.02, LightRain ShuiBroken +0.02 / HuoBroken -0.04, HeavyRain ShuiBroken +0.03 / HuoBroken -0.06. These are modifiers, not full success probabilities.

The ordinary Chance/Gold/FuPractice UI requires at least 99 percent of maximum Ling, enough configured resources/items, CanDoMagic and no already-running bottleneck. It exposes modifier breakdown and target-location factors; RealMode replaces the chance display with unknown. This is the verified UI path, not proof that every alternate command caller repeats all gates.

proposal.journey: After learning existing Measured cooling and completing its three paid trials, choose an optional quiet-hour self trial at the Village bench. Spend one actual salt packet, two stamina and three played minutes. Cool-hour preparation improves the disclosed success weight; an ordinary-hour attempt remains legal. Success retains a narrow steadied-control application; failure retains a failed-attempt progress count plus briefly sore hands. Later choose the new steadied hook method to discharge the same owned sleeve, extending the existing paid hook-field duration from four to five played minutes. Existing four-minute use remains available.

proposal.compatibility: Explicit additive enrollment only; old absence inert, old cooling commands unchanged, frozen jobs retain effects/outcomes/revisions. Introduce only registered command/condition/progress/knowledge IDs through the current integrator; validate optional saved receipt relations in owning schema. No clock/inventory/save-publisher replacement or forced cultivation; same one-realm/one-prestige milestone.
proposal.deliberate_adaptation_difference: YAIRPG freezes paid outcome weights/effects at startCommand. Use a disclosed preparation snapshot at acceptance for this first packet. Do not silently bolt ACS per-dt quality accumulation/live resolution onto frozen jobs; a later variable-environment job policy would be separate integration work.
proposal.later_playable_gate: From a disposable state with the existing method/tool, inspect ordinary versus quiet-hour quote, complete one paid success and one paid failure across separate reproducible seeds, show exact stock/stamina/time consequences and retained application/soreness/retry record, then use the new hook option and show5-minute expiry while normal4 remains. Reload mid-job/after settlement without duplicated costs/result, and preserve old absence/frozen jobs/native save-failure atomicity. All gameplay/unit/browser/save/failure/director checks remain deferred now.
